description: Financial Reporting is a highly configurable Power BI visual designed for detailed financial statement analysis. It supports both table and matrix layouts, making it ideal for income statements, P&L reports, budgets, and other structured financial views. The visual offers extensive formatting and customization options, allowing you to control hierarchy, subtotals, totals, column layouts, and styling to match your reporting standards. It handles multi-level accounts, time-based breakdowns (monthly, yearly), and financial measures with clarity and precision. Whether you need a compact table or a fully expanded financial matrix, Financial Reporting adapts to your data model and presentation needs, delivering clear, professional, and audit-ready financial reports directly inside Power BI.
